_doc: Repo defaults for the antagonistic spec-review gate ('spec gauntlet'). See agents/beacon/specs/spec-gauntlet-gate.md. This is the git-tracked baseline; a live override at ~/agents/spec-review.override.json (OUTSIDE the synced config/ tree so ourliberty-sync never clobbers it) wins over both this repo copy and the synced runtime snapshot. Resolution mirrors trust-policy exactly (override -> runtime -> repo) and is read FRESH on every intercept() call — no module-level cache — so flipping `enabled` in the override takes effect on the next spec with zero daemon restarts. See scripts/spec_review_config.py for the loader.
